title: The Quiet Ledger
author: Coral Zhou
blurb: Noor Villalobos, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
